title: Numbering restarts odp 002
notes: ODP list numbering, second instance: THREE lists on TWO list styles instead of 001's two-on-one — Alpha (4 items) on L1 with NO restart attribute, Bravo (3) on L1 with text:continue-numbering="false", Charlie (3) on a SECOND style L2 (text:num-format="A", lettered markers, 001 only ever shows decimal) also restart-pinned, so restart flags ×2 (001 ×1) and marker formats ×2 meet on one slide; uneven sizes 4+3+3 (001: 5+5). Same honest default-false restart semantics as 001, same draw:frame=2 (no counter matches list elements); reference text is the 10 item strings + title, markers stay render-derived.
